description: The cases of one rule: a drawn text's blocks drawn again behind the parts put in front of it, each under the first tag of its name that nothing in what is sent holds as <tag or </tag and no earlier block took. Three readers each give every case's sent for its parts and its text: Go's texts.InFront (packages/daemon/internal/texts/words.go; TestInFrontGivesWhatTheSharedCasesSay in words_test.go), the TypeScript inFront of @legion/envoy-client/words-block (src/__tests__/words-block.test.ts) and the mod's copy of it in claude-envoy (hooks/words-in-front.ts; tests/words-in-front.test.ts). A line opens a block only where no attribute value holds a raw ", < or >, since the writers of both languages escape all three.
